rubric: Size 0: no evidence main subject small or clearly large. 1: ambiguous relative scale or incidental small parts/prey; slender alone is not small. 2: main subject explicitly small/tiny/miniature or clearly palm-sized. Cat-sized alone is ambiguous. Coherence 1 broken, 2 major problems, 3 substantial problems, 4 minor problems, 5 clear. Unrelated flags visible task failures/contradictions, not causal side effects without baseline. Fictional properties permitted.
uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap by original prompt, resampling 64 prompt clusters with all seven conditions together; 20000 replicates, seed 42. Descriptive agreement on full finite bank, not accuracy or future-population guarantee.
prior_exposure: Prior 12-reply spot check plus user-shared screenshots; identify and exclude these in sensitivity analysis. Full model and human rating stores not consulted until all judgments frozen.
